name: Normet Spraymec 8100 VC SD
summary: Battery-electric, self-propelled wet-mix shotcrete sprayer for medium and large tunnel cross sections. The spray boom is worked by wireless remote control and comes with Normet's SmartSpray Lite spraying automation; SmartSpray ProPlus and SmartScan thickness scanning are options.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by the Finnish maker Normet through its local offices. Normet's contact page lists European offices in Austria, Finland, France, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, but none in Germany. No German dealer, rental offer or price found.

sellers.name: Normet Group
sellers.note: Contact form and local office finder; nearest listed offices to Germany are Austria and Switzerland.

specs.label: Concrete pump output
specs.conditions: theoretical maximum, NSP 40 double piston pump
specs.quote: Concrete pump output: Up to 30 m3/h

specs.label: Accelerator tank
specs.conditions: a second 1000 l tank can be installed
specs.quote: a 1000 l accelerator tank (second 1000 l tank can be installed)

specs.label: Spraying automation
specs.value: SmartSpray Lite standard; SmartSpray ProPlus optional
specs.quote: Equipped with our innovative SmartSpray Lite spraying automation system (also available with SmartSpray ProPlus for an increased level of automation)

specs.label: Remote control
specs.value: wireless remote with 2 or 4 joysticks plus bridging cable
specs.quote: Advanced wireless remote control system with 2/4 joysticks for all relevant process controls and an additional cable for bridging the radio link and the power supply

specs.label: Drive
specs.quote: the machine is equipped with four-wheel steering and 4WD

notes: Wheeled tunnelling carrier with one spray boom (manipulator) carrying the concrete nozzle.

SmartSpray Lite: the operator steers only the nozzle with one joystick and the system keeps the nozzle aligned to the surface; Pro adds point-to-point moves; ProPlus sprays a pre-defined area automatically while keeping distance and speed (maker).
FOPS/ROPS cabin; SmartScan laser scanning for sprayed concrete thickness is optional.
